name: Collapsible Neoprene Can Kooler
description: This classical can cooler are made from neoprene, polyester with foam liner. The foam liner insulates your beverage and absorbs condensation. It features a 3" diameter, that provides a snug fit for most canned and bottled beverages. It is collapsible, and can be folded so quicky for easy storage.You can put it in your pockets, purse and more. Choose from variety of colors to best match your logo, and customize an imprint of your logo or artwork by silkscreen or heat transfer on this neoprene can cooler to create a classical giveaway for summer fun! Your customers, prospects and staffs will like to receive your logoed can cooler that will keep their beer or soda cans cool longer!
